segments.sn23.11:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn23.11:1.5: “Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, māro, vedanā māro, saññā māro, saṅkhārā māro, viññāṇaṃ māro.
segments.sn23.11:1.6: Evaṃ passaṃ, rādha, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati, saññāyapi nibbindati, saṅkhāresupi nibbindati, viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati.
segments.sn23.11:1.7: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati. Vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn23.11:1.8: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.

lines: Yasmā pana rūpādivinimuttaṃ maraṇaṃ nāma natthi, tenassa bhagavā rūpaṃ kho, rādha, mārotiādimāha.
170-181. Rūpādivinimuttaṃ maraṇaṃ nāma natthi rūpādīnaṃyeva vibhave maraṇasamaññāti.
